slides.headline: One Man Designed Both Icons
slides.credit: Photo: Patek Philippe SA / CC BY-SA 4.0

slides.text: Gérald Genta designed the Royal Oak and the Nautilus, Sotheby's says.
Debuted as reference 5402 'Jumbo'. AP's CEO called Genta to save the brand, Sotheby's says.
Sotheby's says the Nautilus took its porthole shape from transatlantic ocean liners.
Genta's first reference 3700 Nautilus debuted for Patek Philippe in 1976.
slides.credit: Photo: Patek Philippe SA / CC BY-SA 4.0

slides.text: Two icons. One designer, per Sotheby's.
